gloss: to put on makeup; to apply cosmetics

definitions.gloss: to put on makeup; to apply cosmetics
definitions.explanation: To apply cosmetic products to one's face or body to enhance appearance.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}{化粧|けしょう}する。
examples.english: I put on makeup every morning.

examples.japanese: {出|で}かける{前|まえ}に{化粧|けしょう}しなきゃ。
examples.english: I need to put on makeup before going out.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{薄|うす}く{化粧|けしょう}しているだけなのに、とても{綺麗|きれい}に{見|み}える。
examples.english: Even though she's only wearing light makeup, she looks very beautiful.

notes:
Refers specifically to the act of applying cosmetics, particularly facial makeup. In everyday speech, the abbreviated form {化粧|けしょう} alone or the expression メイクする is also very common, especially among younger speakers.

The noun {化粧|けしょう} appears in many compounds related to cosmetics and grooming.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {化粧|けしょう}を{落|お}とす: to remove makeup
- {化粧|けしょう}{直|なお}し: makeup touch-up
- {薄化粧|うすげしょう}: light makeup
- {厚化粧|あつげしょう}: heavy makeup
- {化粧品|けしょうひん}: cosmetics
- {化粧水|けしょうすい}: toner; skin lotion
- {化粧|けしょう}ポーチ: makeup pouch

SIMILAR WORDS:
- メイクする: to do makeup — loanword equivalent, common in casual and fashion contexts
- {身支度|みじたく}する: to get ready; to groom oneself — broader term that includes dressing and hair, not just makeup
- {装|よそお}う: to dress up; to adorn oneself — literary, covers overall appearance rather than just cosmetics
